purpose: Scientific animation SPECIFICATION for Profile B (task section 10 & 19). Defines what MAY be animated and at what confidence. NOT an implementation. Every event is tied to evidence + confidence.

scene_sequence.evidence: first-order release r2 0.95-0.96 (dialysis-apparent) - label as apparent release
in-vivo antimelanoma efficacy; spatial route not measured
uptake shown; sub-cellular localization not resolved for P1
no time-series; at most a qualitative risk cue

surface_charge.note: cationic/neutral/anionic visually distinct; explain confound (lipid also differs)

particle_size_region.note: show ~85-90 nm as one region; do NOT animate 84.5 vs 90.2 as distinct

precipitated_API.note: poorly-soluble released drug -> 'precipitation risk increases' cue, NEVER a timed event

surrounding_structures.rule: contextual-visual elements must be visibly distinguished from quantitatively-modeled ones (e.g. greyed/labelled 'illustrative')

time_mapping.permeation: hours (up to 24h Franz) compressed to a short sequence
time_mapping.pharmacodynamics: days shown as a SEPARATE outcome timeline
time_mapping.rule: do NOT imply all processes occur at the same rate; label each timescale

global_rule: No visual effect may contradict the scientific state. Any event marked UNSUPPORTED_DO_NOT_SHOW must be absent or shown only as an explicitly-labelled qualitative risk, never as a deterministic timed animation.
